outcome: Prevalence of urinary incontinence (stress and urge) at 3 and 12 months postpartum
cohort: 2812 primiparous women with twins delivering after 34 weeks of gestation
finding: Vaginal delivery was a significant risk factor for urinary incontinence at both 3 and 12 months postpartum in mothers of twins.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was a significant risk factor for urinary incontinence at both 3 and 12 months postpartum in mothers of twins.
